name: get_issue
description: Get one issue by its number: title, state, author, assignee, labels, milestone, the full description and every comment. Use this to read what an issue asks for before working on it.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: list_issues
description: List the project's issues, newest first, without their descriptions. Filter by state, label or assignee; use get_issue to read one in full.

assignee.description: Only issues assigned to this login.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: add_comment
description: Add a comment to an issue, as the current user. Markdown is supported. Comments are visible to everyone who can see the issue and notify its subscribers.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

reply_to.description: The id of a comment this one answers, to thread it.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: search_issues
description: Search issues by words in their titles and descriptions. Returns matching issues without their descriptions, best match first. Supports open and closed issues.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: create_issue
description: Create a new issue in the project. The current user becomes its author. Labels, an assignee and a milestone can be set at once.

assignee.description: The login to assign it to.

name: close_issue
description: Close an issue, optionally with a reason. Closing notifies the issue's subscribers. A closed issue can be reopened with reopen_issue.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

name: reopen_issue
description: Reopen a closed issue. Its comments and labels are kept. Reopening notifies the issue's subscribers.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

comment.description: A comment to add while reopening.

name: assign_issue
description: Assign an issue to a user, replacing the current assignee. Pass no login to unassign it. The new assignee is notified.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

login.description: Who to assign it to; omit to unassign.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

name: add_label
description: Add a label to an issue. The label must exist in the project (see list_labels). Adding a label the issue already has does nothing.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

name: remove_label
description: Remove a label from an issue. Removing a label the issue doesn't have does nothing. The label itself stays in the project.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

name: list_labels
description: List the labels defined in the project, with their descriptions. Use their names with add_label, remove_label and the label filters.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: get_user
description: Get a user by login: their display name and role in the project. Use list_users to find a login.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: list_users
description: List the project's members with their logins, display names and roles. Useful for assigning issues or mentioning people.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

role.description: Only members with this role (e.g. maintainer).

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: list_milestones
description: List the project's milestones with their due dates and descriptions, soonest first. Issues can belong to one milestone.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: get_milestone
description: Get one milestone by title: its due date, its description, and the issues in it with their states. Shows how far along it is.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: link_pull_request
description: Link a pull request to an issue, so the issue shows it and closes when the pull request is merged. Both must be in the same project.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

closes.description: Close the issue when it's merged (default true).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

name: list_comments
description: List an issue's comments, oldest first, with their ids and authors. get_issue includes them too; this one pages through long threads.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

since.description: Only comments after this comment id.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: edit_comment
description: Change the text of a comment you wrote. The comment shows that it was edited. Other people's comments can't be edited.

comment_id.description: The comment's id (from get_issue or list_comments).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

name: delete_comment
description: Delete a comment you wrote. This can't be undone. Other people's comments can't be deleted.

comment_id.description: The comment's id (from get_issue or list_comments).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

name: get_project
description: Get the project's details: its key, name, description, and how many issues are open and closed.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: list_projects
description: List the projects on this tracker that you can see, with their keys and names. Most trackers here hold one project.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: subscribe
description: Subscribe to an issue: you'll be notified of its comments and changes. Authors and assignees are subscribed already.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

name: unsubscribe
description: Stop being notified about an issue. You can subscribe again at any time.

number.description: The issue's number, as shown in the tracker (e.g. 12 for #12).

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

name: get_activity
description: Get the project's recent activity: issues opened, closed and commented on, newest first. Good for a summary of what happened lately.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.

name: export_issues
description: Export the project's issues as CSV or JSON, descriptions included. Large projects produce large exports: prefer list_issues or search_issues to find something.

project.description: The project's key (e.g. UTIL), as list_projects shows it. Defaults to the only project this tracker holds; required when it holds several.

fields.description: Only these fields of each item (e.g. ["number", "title", "state"]). Default: all of them. Unknown names are ignored.
